tables.COURSE_TYPE_SUBJECT_SCHEMA: course, semester wise subject master details. join as coursecode,semcode,subjectcode
tables.GRADE_DETAILS: This table defines grading scales for courses, where each row represents a score range band and its corresponding grade value for a specific course and session combination. The columns START_RANGE and END_RANGE define the percentage boundaries (e.g., 95-100), while GRADE_VALUE contains the numeric grade points awarded for that range, keyed by COURSECD, SESSCODE, and GRADE_ID. Use this table to look up or convert raw scores into grade values, or join to it when building reports that need to map student marks to their corresponding grades for a given course session.
tables.TRPASSOUTDATATABLE: This table stores comprehensive semester-wise academic results for passed-out students, with one row per student keyed by STUDENTCODE (or ROLL_NO/ENROLL_NO). Each row contains marks obtained (OBT_SEM1-10), total marks (TOT_SEM1-10), pass/fail results (RESULT_SEM1-10), examination periods (YEAR_SEM1-10), credits earned (CRDT_SEM1-10), and SGPA values for up to 10 semesters. Use this table when building reports on student academic performance, graduation records, or calculating cumulative scores across semesters.
tables.TRPRINTSTUDENTDETAILS: This table stores student examination results and details for printing/reporting purposes, with one row per student per course, keyed by STUDENTCODE and TRCOURSECODE. Each row contains student biographical information (STUDENTNAME, FATHERSNAME, MOTHERSNAME, STUDENTSEX), enrollment details (EXAMROLLNUMBER, COLLEGECODE, COLLEGENAME, COURSENAME), and comprehensive exam results including theory and practical marks (THEOOBT, PRACOBT, TOTAL), credit information (TRCREDIT, COURSETOTALCREDIT), and grade metrics (COURSE_SGPA, RESULT). Use this table when generating student transcripts, marksheets, or result reports, and join via STUDENTCODE for student master data or COLLEGECODE for institution details.
tables.TRROOTMASTER: COURSE,SYLLABUS,semester,session,studenttype,resulttype wise trcoursecode master details, join as trcoursecode,trsemcode,sesscode,coursecode,syllcode,studenttype,resulttype
